title: Deteriorate
summary: DETERIORATE, verb intransitive [Latin] To grow worse; to be impaired in quality to degenerate; opposed to meliorate. DETERIORATE, verb transitive To make worse; to reduce in quality; as, to deteriorat

inlines.v: DETERIORATE, verb intransitive [Latin] To grow worse; to be impaired in quality to degenerate; opposed to meliorate. DETERIORATE, verb transitive To make worse; to reduce in quality; as, to deteriorate a race of men of their condition.
